acceptance.given: The canonical TC-D1 execution-plan directory is the only in-scope TC-D1 requirement tree, and the plan validator is given a proposed additional TC-D1 requirement-tree directory.

oracle.expected: The validator rejects the proposal with a scope-boundary validation failure, leaving only the canonical TC-D1 requirement tree in scope.
forbidden: The additional tree is accepted as a TC-D1 requirement tree.
The additional tree is used as a replacement for or bypass of the canonical package.
oracle.observable: The validator's nonzero result and validation errors identify the proposed additional TC-D1 requirement tree as outside the canonical plan boundary.

acceptance.then: The canonical plan remains the sole TC-D1 requirement-tree authority.
acceptance.when: A creation or adoption of an additional TC-D1 requirement tree is proposed or attempted.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Inject a second TC-D1 requirement-tree proposal into the plan-boundary input and require the validator to reject that structural scope violation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make the repository Toolchain plan validator reject a proposed additional TC-D1 requirement tree, so no replacement or parallel requirement tree can enter the canonical package scope.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Removing the boundary check restores the prior validator behavior only; it does not alter canonical requirement-tree contents or lifecycle state.

slice_hint.state_transition: A proposed additional TC-D1 requirement tree moves from proposed to deterministically rejected; the canonical tree remains the only in-scope tree.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The boundary-validation test observes rejection of the injected additional TC-D1 requirement tree and confirms that no replacement or parallel tree is accepted.
